scopeNotes: This is an internal service/repository slice. It intentionally exposes no server function, UI, MCP tool, scheduler or caller-supplied authorization boundary.

Action targets and events expose no application update/delete methods. The Action projection changes only through versioned state transitions; title, description, due date, source, inherited category/priority and targets remain immutable.
The pure Growth target normalizer now serves Recommendations and Actions, preventing canonicalization drift without changing existing Recommendation behavior.
Occurrence timestamps are generated by the atomic writer and excluded from semantic event hashes, so delayed exact retries remain stable.
Owner assignment, website Change Events, implementation notes, Measurement records and external surfaces remain deferred.
